name: GOV monad-protocols: GovSetGovernorAdmin (Euler V2 EVault)
description: Euler V2 EVault: GovSetGovernorAdmin(address) emitted by a contract tagged mf-privileged. Default severity critical. The privChangeGuard Web3 Action decodes the change, classifies the holder (EOA, EIP-7702, Safe, timelock) and checks for prior notice.
